picks.title: What Is Artex? The AI Hacking Tool Linked to the US Spy Agency Breach
picks.summary: Microsoft says state-backed hackers and cybercriminals are using Artex to automate attacks with AI agents, exploiting familiar security flaws at speeds that leave defenders little time to respond or recover.

picks.title: The 1Password Breach Didn’t Touch Your Vault. The Phishing Emails Might
picks.summary: An attacker compromised an employee’s GitHub account to reach 1Password’s backend and copy customer names and emails, but the company says vault contents, encryption keys and your Secret Key were never exposed.

picks.title: Bitcoin miners hit by hashrate hijacking attack exploiting unencrypted connections
picks.summary: Braiins warns that an attacker is redirecting miners compute power to steal bitcoin mining rewards.

picks.title: Standard Chartered s Zodia Custody suffers data breach, exposing client information
Zodia Custody Confirms Client and Staff Data Breach
picks.summary: The Standard Chartered-backed crypto custodian detected the breach on Nov. 23. The exposed information included names and email addresses, its CEO told Reuters.

picks.title: Standard Chartered s Zodia Custody Says Hackers Accessed Client Contact Details
picks.summary: The crypto custodian said an unauthorized party accessed some client and staff names and emails, but found no unauthorized transactions.

picks.title: UK Regulator Cites Binance Hack as It Plans Tougher DeFi Rules Than US and EU: Report
picks.summary: The FCA plans to require DeFi platforms to be authorized and to keep regulated exchanges from routing UK retail trades to them.

picks.title: Cyprus Becomes Espionage Target for Iranian Hackers
picks.summary: A previously undocumented Iranian threat group called Volant Manticore is targeting Cypriot organizations as part of an intelligence-gathering effort for Tehran.

picks.title: Draining peatlands is responsible for a few percent of our global warming
picks.summary: Detailed estimate going back to 1800 shows how much carbon is being liberated.

picks.title: SYS010 malware abuses browser management to spy on Gmail, Outlook
picks.summary: A new version of the SYS01 infostealer malware delivered through Meta ads is enrolling browsers into enterprise-style management to force the installation of an extension that steals sensitive data, including Gmail and Outlook emails. [...]
